visualReview.method: Independent visual inspection of rendered Word-exported PDF after native chart-data activation; original ChartEx is visually assessed without claiming classic COM series support.
visualReview.observed: One portrait page. New rsword chart at top has blue columns 3, 1, 2. Original waterfall remains below with Chinese sales-statistics title and three blue ascending floating columns from 0-10, 10-30 and 30-60, labeled 1/2/3. Both complete chart frames and before/after are visible without overlap. Original ChartEx text is rasterized in the PDF and is therefore not present in ordinary PDF text extraction.
